title: Workers list operator controls for scheduling state and labels
intended_behavior: Workers list rows present liveness and scheduling state as separate operator-visible indicators.
Operators can filter workers by scheduling state, workload/task kind, label key/value, accelerator, runtime, and online-only liveness.

Per-row actions publish signed Nostr worker command requests for cordon, uncordon, drain, undrain, maintenance enter, maintenance exit, and label updates through the existing frontend publishCommand request/result flow.
The page does not directly mutate worker state; successful UI feedback comes after the correlated worker result event is received.
observed_baseline: Before this slice, the workers list showed only one liveness-style status badge per row.
Before this slice, filters did not include scheduling state, labels, online-only, or generic workload-kind handling.
Before this slice, no row-level worker scheduling or label command publication controls existed on the workers list.
out_of_scope: Backend Go command handlers, repositories, scheduling enforcement, MCP worker tools, and worker assignment/drain read models.
